steps.title: Start with 2 rails and a board
steps.instruction: Join 2 rails and a board (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: 2 rails and a board are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the LANTLIV furniture. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (rail, about 20 cm), B (rail, about 20 cm), C (board, about 78 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 80 cm tall.
